project: Bright Memory: Infinite Android graphics integration

settings.label: Resolution Controller
settings.integration_point: bmi.SetResolutionController 0..6 -> r.MobileContentScaleFactor using existing game values
settings.note: Native must preserve physical display resolution, aspect ratio, orientation and Android system DPI.

settings.label: Graphics Quality
settings.integration_point: UGameUserSettings scalability categories and supported mobile CVars
settings.note: Each tier must change actual shadow, view distance, effects, texture, foliage, shading and post-processing settings where supported; do not expose until visual validation.

settings.label: Render Scale
settings.note: Game already has native resolution-scale setters; wire the unified menu to the existing GameUserSettings path instead of adding a second scale system.

settings.label: Upscaling Method

methods.SGSR1: official_Qualcomm_UE4_27_plugin_source_and_mobile_shader_vendored_under_engine-extension/renderer/vendor/SGSR1; opt-in CVar; runtime sharpness slider wired to shader parameter; not compiled into Bright Memory
methods.SGSR2: official temporal algorithm source exists upstream; not integrated; requires motion vectors, history and UE4.27 temporal pipeline integration
methods.MWSR: algorithm source and UE4.27 integration not verified; unavailable
methods.FSR Lite: not an official AMD feature name; FSR1 source/integration not yet ported; unavailable
methods.Nearest: native Renderer bridge source; uses UE4.27 AddDefaultUpscalePass; not compiled into target
methods.Bilinear: native Renderer bridge source; uses UE4.27 AddDefaultUpscalePass; not compiled into target

integration_requirements: Install vendored SGSR1 plugin as Engine/Plugins/Runtime/SGSR (folder name must be SGSR because plugin shader mapping looks up FindPlugin('SGSR')) and enable SGSR1.uplugin in the game project
Copy BMISpatialUpscaler.h/.cpp into Engine/Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private and apply 0001-register-bmi-spatial-upscaler.patch
Compile exact Bright Memory Android UE4.27 target and validate Vulkan before exposing menu controls
SGSR2, MWSR and FSR Lite remain unavailable until their complete renderer passes are ported

settings.label: Frame Generation
settings.integration_point: separate_interpolation_stage_before_present; requires real motion estimation/interpolation and frame pacing coordination
settings.note: Qualcomm Adreno Neural Fusion provides Frame Generation only in UE5 plugin branches (UE5.0–5.8), not UE4.27. Do not transplant UE5 plugin into this UE4.27 game.

settings.label: Frame Pacing
settings.note: SwappyGL exports alone do not prove Vulkan path uses Swappy; Vulkan Present has its own RenderThreadPacing path.

settings.label: Low Latency
settings.integration_point: bmi.SetLowLatency 0=Off, 1=UE4 r.OneFrameThreadLag 0 supported low-latency thread sync, 2=Ultra No Queue rejected until Vulkan queue depth control is verified
settings.safety: No vkQueueWaitIdle per frame; Ultra No Queue is not enabled or claimed

settings.label: Performance HUD
integration_evidence: FPerformanceTrackingSystem::AnalyzeFrame(float) @ 0x852dd6c uses clock_gettime and maintains frame-duration samples
settings.note: CPU/GPU utilization require separate Android/vendor telemetry; GAverageFPS and frame timing internals are not a complete GPU utilization API.

settings.label: FPS Limit
settings.integration_point: UGameUserSettings::SetFrameRateLimit(float) @ 0x87359dc stores limit; SetFrameRateLimitCVar(float) @ 0x87340ec forwards to GameUserSettings interface vtable slot +0x2e8; GetFramePace @ 0x8735500 delegates to FAndroidPlatformRHIFramePacer

implementation_note: Source integration work is in progress. Resolution controller, graphics quality, render scale, preset selection, SGSR1 vendor source/sharpness and safe UE4 low-latency command bindings have source changes. SGSR2/MWSR/FSR Lite and AMD CAS still require native renderer passes; nothing is compiled into the Bright Memory APK.
integration_constraints: The game binary identifies its build source path as UE4.27Plus; exact engine patch version still needs confirmation.
Target libUE4.so does not contain SGSR1, SGSR2, or Mobile FSR plugin CVar strings searched; plugin integration is not already present.
A plugin built for UE4.27 requires matching engine/project build and cooked shader integration; a loose plugin folder or menu toggle cannot add its native renderer code to an already shipped APK.
No game project source/UE4 build environment is present in this research repository, so a valid modified libUE4.so/APK cannot be produced from static analysis alone.
Keep all controls hidden until native implementation is compiled and tested.
